utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Ira, what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m heading out to spread the word and see who can help with tools or supplies. I’ll check back in later with whatever I’ve managed to gather.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good—who should I contact if I can help gather tools or supplies too?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, Noah — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I could really use a hammer and maybe a screwdriver if you’ve got one.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ve got both and I can bring them by. Just let me know where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard they’re still collecting supplies for the repair drive. If you’ve got anything spare, it’d really help out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I might have a few things, but I’d want to check what they still need first so I don’t bring the wrong stuff.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That makes sense — I can check the latest list and let you know what they’re still short on. Then you can bring exactly what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive, Opal—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you head to the community center and check the donation bin? Then bring anything usable back to my porch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check the donation bin at the community center and bring anything usable back to your porch.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’ve been telling everyone about it—if you want, I can send you the details and get you added right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. Please send me the details—I may be able to help a little.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send you the details and add you in right away. Even a little help would be great!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I’m putting together the repair drive details now—what supplies or help do you think we should prioritize?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’d prioritize basic tools, work gloves, duct tape, and first-aid supplies. If we can get a few handy volunteers too, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That makes sense—I'll put basic tools, gloves, duct tape, and first-aid at the top of the list, and I’ll ask for a few volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I commit to anything, can you tell me what the repair drive needs and when it’s supposed to happen?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late to the details, but I think they’re still gathering repair items and volunteers. I’ll check and get you the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that’d help. I’ll wait for the exact time and list before I decide.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule, just let me know what time the repair drive needs us. I’ll see what we can make work.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — that’d help a lot. I’m still pinning down the time, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — just send it over when you know, and I’ll work around the kids’ schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet. How’s it going so far?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s going pretty well so far — we’ve got a few volunteers lined up and a decent start on supplies. Still need a bit more help, though.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great to hear — I can spread the word and see if anyone else around here can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit swamped, but I can help if you keep it quick.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you can help, then? Just checking—what part can you do quickly?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can handle a quick donation drop-off or help sort items for a few minutes. Just point me to the simplest part.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I heard about it. I can stop by and see what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be great, Rey. Thank you—just come by and take a look whenever you can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I’ll swing by later today and see what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll pass it along and keep folks posted about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and let you know if we’re short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Cleo—if anything runs low, tell me and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—did the repair drive get enough help?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think it’s still a little short, but a few more people showed up today. We may need one more push to be safe.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like it’s close, but not quite there yet. I’ll keep an ear out and see if anyone else in the neighborhood can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help however I can; just remind me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great—thanks, Oren. I’ll remind you once I’ve got the list sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik. Just send me the list when it’s ready, and I’ll do my best to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but what do we need to fix?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We mostly need to sort the broken lamp and that loose fence board. I can bring the tools if you can check who’s available.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can check who’s around and see if anyone can help. The lamp and fence board sound doable.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can lend a hand—what do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ve got a simple list: boxes for donations, a sign-up sheet, and maybe a few volunteers to help sort things.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can bring some boxes and a sign-up sheet, and I’ll ask around for a couple folks to help sort.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara — could you help spread the word and invite a few neighbors to bring tools or spare parts? I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can spread the word and invite a few neighbors to bring tools or spare parts. I’ll reach out today.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I’m happy to help bridge folks together for the repair drive—what still needs sorting out?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still tracking where the drop-off supplies and the repair kits are, so I can point folks to the right place.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that—let me check where the drop-off supplies and repair kits are being kept, then I’ll point everyone the right way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely—we can get the repair drive organized and keep everything moving smoothly. What do you need from me first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: First I need to know what tools and supplies you’ve already got, so I can see what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got a basic toolkit, some screwdrivers, duct tape, zip ties, and a few work gloves. I’ll check my storage this afternoon and let you know the full list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard about the repair drive from a couple folks—sounds like a good thing. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Mostly we still need hands and a list of what needs fixing. Can you help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I can do that and ask around for the list too. Just point me to who I should talk to.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you help sort the donated items and label anything that’s still working? I’m trying to keep it moving before school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can do that. I’ll sort through the donated items and mark what still works.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just to confirm, you’re definitely in for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m definitely in — count me on the repair drive.
